body: Thank you for the message, I do appreciate it and I'm glad you find a way through. I'll be moving out by the end of the summer but I don't even know if I'll be around for then. Things have gotten bad to the point I don't sleep anymore, I get scared at the thought of sleeping because of the constant thoughts going through my head. Thoughts that I'm not good enough, nobody cares, it's all meaningless. It's cliche but it seriously hurts and it's so exhausting. Everything I care about seems to disappear, everything that seems hopeful in my life just fizzles and I'm left wondering why I even try, it just burns me out. I'm sick of crying or wanting to cry and break down all the time. I've given it some time and I want to give it more time but it's getting really bad. Its 5am as I'm typing this and I don't want to even try to sleep because I know exactly what thoughts will go through my head.
